other_text:
When blood becomes ink & ink becomes paint,
When fate is conjured, you will feel it in your veins.
And you will be a part of the alchemy.
To alter reality.
The just piece to take,
Now is the moment to do.
Now is the moment to imagine.
moderation_notes: Contains stylized blood imagery and occult themes.
description: A poster with a stark white background, red splatters resembling blood, and poetic text about transformation and alchemy.
